title: Apps
catalogDescription: Community-verified apps that work on Meta Portal devices
visitorCatalogDescription: Browse community-verified apps before connecting a Meta Portal
visitorConnectHint: You can browse the catalog without a device. Connect your Portal when you want to install an app or check what is already installed.
dropToInstall: Drop the .apk file to install it
dragDropApk: Drag & drop an APK file here, or click to browse
requiresDescription: Needs {{deps}} to run. Install it first?
readmeError: Couldn't load the README from GitHub
notAnApk: That file is not an APK
setupNoticeAuto: Installing also grants this app extra permissions on your Portal
setupNoticeManual: This app can be granted extra permissions on your Portal
setupNoticeIntro: OpenPortal runs these ADB commands on your device. Nothing leaves your Portal:
setupConfirmIntro: To work on your Portal, {{name}} needs extra permissions that aren't exposed in settings. OpenPortal can run these ADB commands on your device right after installing:
setupConfirmHint: If you turn this off, you can run it later from the app's setup button.
dragDropToInstall: Drag & drop the APK to install
uninstallConfirm: Are you sure you want to uninstall {{name}}?
uninstallRevertConfirm: This first reverts {{name}}'s provisioning (restores the stock launcher, screensaver, and install verifier), then uninstalls. If it is a device admin, you'll deactivate it on the Portal.
uninstallDeviceAdmin: {{name}} is a device admin, so Android blocks the uninstall. A deactivation screen was opened on the Portal: tap Deactivate there, then uninstall again.
uninstallDeviceAdminImmortal: Immortal is a device admin, so Android blocks the uninstall. Immortal was opened on the Portal: go to its Settings, then Device health, then tap "Disable screen-off admin", then uninstall again.
manageInstalledDesc: Manage apps installed on your Portal
clearDataConfirm: Clear all data and cache for {{name}}? You can't undo this.

provisioning.intro: Runs Immortal's full ADB setup: installs and sets the launcher and screensaver, and unlocks on-device installs so its store works. Reversible with Restore.
provisioning.commandsTitle: Show the commands that will run
provisioning.incompatible: This program needs a newer OpenPortal. Using the built-in version instead.
provisioning.needDevice: Connect a Portal to run provisioning.
provisioning.restoreConfirmMsg: This puts back Meta's launcher, screensaver, and install verifier, and re-enables OS updates. Immortal stays installed. You can re-provision anytime.
provisioning.resetLauncherHint: Immortal is your Portal's home screen.
provisioning.fleetDownloadHint: Save this device's fleet record (name, IP, agent token) for the laptop fleet tool. It replaces the file the kit writes locally.

opt.blockOtaHint: Stops a future Meta OTA from undoing this setup. Forgoes OS updates; reversible.
opt.disableOtaHint: Stops a future Meta OTA from undoing this setup. Forgoes OS updates; reversible.
opt.installShizukuHint: Privileged broker used by some apps (e.g. Aurora's silent installs). Useful on every Portal.
opt.runPreinstallsHint: Installs the apps listed in Immortal's config (if any) during setup.
opt.disablePresenceHint: Turns off Meta's camera-based presence. Loses empty-room sleep smarts; off by default.
opt.enableFleetHint: Runs Immortal's in-app agent so you can manage this Portal over Wi-Fi. Survives reboot.
opt.setLauncherHint: Makes Immortal the Portal's home screen. Turn off to keep Meta's launcher (e.g. Calls); you can still open Immortal manually. Reversible with Restore.
opt.restoreAlexaHint: Revives the original on-device Alexa client (hands-free "Hey Alexa"). Downloads ~115 MB.
opt.restoreAlexaDisabled: Not supported on this Portal (Android 10+ blocks background mic for sideloaded apps).

msgs.deviceAdmin: Couldn't enable screen-off device admin; screensaver sleep won't work. Re-run setup.
msgs.shizukuStarter: Couldn't find Shizuku's starter; open the Shizuku app and tap Start once.
msgs.shizukuStay: Shizuku server didn't stay up (some firmware kills it). Open the Shizuku app and tap Start, or skip Shizuku and set Aurora Store to its Session installer.
msgs.noOverlay: No installer overlay to disable (already fixed, or not a Gen-1).
msgs.fleetNoToken: Fleet agent didn't report a token. Open Immortal once, then enable the fleet agent again.
msgs.alexaA10: Alexa not supported on Android 10+ (background mic is blocked for sideloaded apps).
msgs.alexaTimeout: Alexa didn't connect in time. Check Wi-Fi and that the Amazon account is linked, then retry.
msgs.deviceAdminRemove: Couldn't remove the device admin from here. Deactivate it on the Portal, then uninstall.
msgs.alexaFalconKept: Alexa (falcon) is left installed on purpose; removing it would register a new device with Amazon.
